correctness.rationale: The triple has a unique common point P=[0:1:0], pairwise residual points A,B,C_lambda collinear on y=0, intrinsically constraining any projectivity to matrix [ax+bz:hy:dx+ez]. Six possible member permutations and residual line actions yield exactly the six equations (lambda-mu)(lambda*mu-1)(lambda+mu+1)(lambda*mu+lambda+1)(lambda*mu+mu+1)(lambda*mu+lambda+mu)=0. Each case has an explicit invertible projective map from the frozen RESULT.md; the inspected exact rational-function verifier checks every conic pullback. Independently factored J(lambda)-J(mu) and verified invariance under all six transforms. The S3 action stabilizers give exceptional C2 and C3 loci; no larger stabilizers occur for allowed lambda.
